subject: Urgent coordination: same-day candidate illness — convert to recorded coding exercise?
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: hiring-panel@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-03T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Interview confirmation — Liam O'Connor (Mon 3 Aug, 11:00 PT)

Hi all,

Quick confirmation for today's final round with Liam O'Connor (Applied Infra Eng). Schedule below: 11:00–11:45 PT (coding exercise + 15min debrief). Candidate is booked onsite; travel ETA was 10:20 — hotel is nearby. Agenda and the quick rubric are attached (interview_agenda_v2.pdf).

Can the panel please:
- Confirm availability for live session at 11:00
- Mark if you can review a recorded coding exercise if we need to accept a recording instead (we may need this as a fallback)

Tessa — I'm including you as backup for logistics and reimbursements in case travel gets messy. Markus, Marissa — please flag if you can cover the on-site portion if anyone drops.

Thanks,
Priya
Priya Natarajan
Senior Recruiter, Talent Acquisition
Redwood Inference

Attachment: interview_agenda_v2.pdf (10KB)
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@gmail.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-03T10:57:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interview confirmation — Liam O'Connor (Mon 3 Aug, 11:00 PT)

Hi Priya / Tessa —

I'm really sorry — I woke up with a high fever and have been advised to avoid travel today. I'm gutted about the timing; I was on my way to the hotel when it got worse.

If it helps the process, I'm happy to:
- Do a recorded 45-minute coding exercise (I can record my screen + voice) that you can hand off to the panel to review, or
- Reschedule to the earliest possible slot you have this week (I can be flexible afternoons PT).

Apologies again for the disruption. Let me know what you'd prefer and I can start the recording immediately if that's easiest.

Best,
Liam

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: hiring-ops@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-03T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interview confirmation — Liam O'Connor (Mon 3 Aug, 11:00 PT)

Folks —

Thanks for the heads-up, Priya, and thanks for being proactive, Liam. Given this is same-day and travel is already in motion for some panelists, here are two operational paths. Please reply with a quick thumbs-up for the option you can support: 

Option A — Convert to recorded:
- Candidate records 45-minute coding session (screen + voice).
- Panelists review asynchronously within 48 hours and submit short notes in the Greenhouse interview form.
- We treat recording as equivalent to a live session for hiring decisioning (will need consensus on rubric).

Option B — Hold a reduced live panel at 11:00 with on-site folks and have the candidate do 30 mins of live Q&A (if they can hop on phone) and we slot a recorded exercise afterwards.

Operational notes:
- If we go with Option A, I will send standard recording instructions and a drive folder for uploads (see recording_instructions.md attached).
- If anyone is unable to commit to asynchronous review, please call that out now — we need at least 3 reviewers for parity.
- Priya — if candidate incurs travel expenses due to hotel/no-show, please confirm our policy and whether we should proactively reimburse travel tonight.

Please reply with either "A-recorded" or "B-live+short" and whether you can review the recording by Friday. I'll coordinate next steps immediately.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Hiring Operations Lead
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Interview confirmation — Liam O'Connor (Mon 3 Aug, 11:00 PT)

A-recorded from me — I can review by EOD Friday.

Notes / logistics:
- Priya: please ask Liam to upload the recording to the Drive folder linked below and include the raw screen capture + short README with how long he spent on each task. That makes review faster.
- I'll take lead on consolidating reviewer notes into Greenhouse and will run the debrief doc once everyone has submitted.
- For travel, if he's already checked into the hotel, reimburse standard taxi/ride + one-night lodging; we can confirm with finance after you check receipts.

I'll ping on Slack if anything changes.

Marissa Cole

Redwood Inference
